label: My return: words

params.name: lede
params.default: {name}: drop in your documents - we read them, check them against each other and work out both tax regimes. You file the JSON on the e-filing portal.
params.label: lede

params.name: pick_lede
params.default: Whose return? Pick the person - an individual or HUF.
params.label: pick_lede

params.name: pick_none
params.default: No individual or HUF clients yet. Add one under Clients & years.
params.label: pick_none

params.name: gather_p
params.default: Start with the pre-filled JSON - it carries your details, salary, TDS and bank accounts. Then the AIS, and Form 16 from each employer. Drop them in any order; each one is read as it arrives.
params.label: gather_p

params.name: drop
params.default: Drop a document here, or choose one
params.label: drop

params.name: drop_hint
params.default: Pre-filled JSON · AIS (JSON, CSV or PDF) · Form 16 (PDF) · 26AS (text or PDF) · bank statement (PDF, Excel or CSV)
params.label: drop_hint

params.name: pw_ph
params.default: AIS / 26AS: your PAN in small letters + date of birth DDMMYYYY
params.label: pw_ph

params.name: ai_ok
params.default: Read Form 16 Part B with AI when its layout is unusual - the page goes to Google Gemini on this portal's key and nothing is kept there
params.label: ai_ok

params.name: k_prefill_why
params.default: Your details, salary from your employer's TDS returns, TDS, taxes paid and bank accounts - straight from the department.
params.label: k_prefill_why

params.name: k_prefill_how
params.default: Sign in at incometax.gov.in|e-File > Income Tax Returns > Download Pre-Filled Data|Pick AY {ay} and download the JSON|Drop it here
params.label: k_prefill_how

params.name: k_ais_why
params.default: Interest, dividends, sales of shares and funds, and every TDS the department knows about.
params.label: k_ais_why

params.name: k_ais_how
params.default: Sign in at incometax.gov.in|Services > Annual Information Statement (AIS) > Proceed|Choose FY 2025-26, then AIS > Download (JSON or PDF)|The PDF's password is your PAN in small letters with your date of birth, e.g. abcde1234f01011990
params.label: k_ais_how

params.name: k_form16_why
params.default: Your employer's certificate: Part A (TDS by quarter) and Part B (salary, allowances, deductions). One per employer.
params.label: k_form16_why

params.name: k_form16_how
params.default: Ask your employer's HR or payroll - it is due by 15 June|Usually a signed PDF; Part A comes from TRACES|Changed jobs in the year? Bring one from each employer
params.label: k_form16_how

params.name: k_26as_why
params.default: Your tax credit as the department holds it: TDS by deductor and taxes you paid. The return is checked against it.
params.label: k_26as_why

params.name: k_26as_how
params.default: Sign in at incometax.gov.in|e-File > Income Tax Returns > View Form 26AS > Confirm|Pick AY {ay}, view as Text, export|Drop the text file (or the PDF) here
params.label: k_26as_how

params.name: check_p
params.default: The same figure from two documents, side by side. A gap is not always wrong - a TDS deposited late may not show in 26AS yet - but it is better seen now than in a notice.
params.label: check_p

params.name: check_none
params.default: Nothing to compare yet - drop in Form 16 and 26AS or the AIS.
params.label: check_none

params.name: lv_amber
params.default: {a} here, not in the other document - worth a look
params.label: lv_amber

params.name: old_closed
params.default: The old regime can only be chosen in a return filed by the due date (31 July) - a belated return is under the new regime.
params.label: old_closed

params.name: verdict_same
params.default: Both regimes come to the same tax - the new regime needs nothing more from you.
params.label: verdict_same

params.name: rv_cg_p
params.default: From the AIS or your broker's capital-gains statement. Anything here other than 112A gains up to 1.25 lakh makes it an ITR-2.
params.label: rv_cg_p

params.name: rv_via_p
params.default: As your employer declared them in Form 16, or what you type. The old regime allows them all; the new only the employer's NPS (80CCD(2)).
params.label: rv_via_p

params.name: no_salary
params.default: No salary yet - drop Form 16, or add an employer.
params.label: no_salary

params.name: no_house
params.default: No house property. Add one if you own a home or let one out.
params.label: no_house

params.name: q_resident
params.default: I lived in India for 182 days or more in FY 2025-26
params.label: q_resident

params.name: q_director
params.default: I was a director of a company
params.label: q_director

params.name: q_unlisted
params.default: I held unlisted shares at some time in the year
params.label: q_unlisted

params.name: q_foreign
params.default: I have assets or income outside India
params.label: q_foreign

params.name: q_parents_senior
params.default: A parent I pay health cover for is 60 or older
params.label: q_parents_senior

params.name: q_metro
params.default: I rented in Mumbai, Delhi, Kolkata or Chennai
params.label: q_metro

params.name: emp_cats
params.default: OTH=Private company or others|CGOV=Central Government|SGOV=State Government|PSU=Public sector undertaking|PE=Pensioner - Central Government|PESG=Pensioner - State Government|PEPS=Pensioner - public sector|PEO=Pensioner - others|NA=Not employed
params.label: emp_cats

params.name: states
params.default: 01=Andaman and Nicobar Islands|02=Andhra Pradesh|03=Arunachal Pradesh|04=Assam|05=Bihar|06=Chandigarh|07=Dadra and Nagar Haveli|08=Daman and Diu|09=Delhi|10=Goa|11=Gujarat|12=Haryana|13=Himachal Pradesh|14=Jammu and Kashmir|15=Karnataka|16=Kerala|17=Lakshadweep|18=Madhya Pradesh|19=Maharashtra|20=Manipur|21=Meghalaya|22=Mizoram|23=Nagaland|24=Odisha|25=Puducherry|26=Punjab|27=Rajasthan|28=Sikkim|29=Tamil Nadu|30=Tripura|31=Uttar Pradesh|32=West Bengal|33=Chhattisgarh|34=Uttarakhand|35=Jharkhand|36=Telangana|37=Ladakh
params.label: states

params.name: ready_h
params.default: Before you start: keep these handy
params.label: ready_h

params.name: ready_p
params.default: Ten minutes of gathering saves an hour of guessing. Each one you drop in below ticks itself; tick the rest as you have them.
params.label: ready_p

params.name: k_filed_why
params.default: Already filed? Drop in the JSON you filed and every figure is set beside this one.
params.label: k_filed_why

params.name: k_filed_how
params.default: Sign in at incometax.gov.in|e-File > Income Tax Returns > View Filed Returns|Pick AY {ay} and download the JSON (or keep the one you uploaded)|Drop it here
params.label: k_filed_how

params.name: no_filed
params.default: No filed return in this one yet - drop in the JSON you filed.
params.label: no_filed

params.name: filed_p
params.default: Give the day you filed - the dates, the late fee, interest and the regime are then worked out as of that day.
params.label: filed_p

params.name: cmp_h
params.default: Compared with the return you filed
params.label: cmp_h

params.name: cmp_p
params.default: {file}: {filed} as filed, {ours} as made here. A gap means one of the two has a figure the other does not.
params.label: cmp_p

params.name: cmp_same
params.default: Every figure agrees with the return you filed.
params.label: cmp_same

params.name: why_simple
params.default: ITR-1 (Sahaj) fits: resident, income up to 50 lakh, salary, up to two houses and other sources.
params.label: why_simple

params.name: why_nonres
params.default: ITR-2, because you were not resident in India this year.
params.label: why_nonres

params.name: why_income
params.default: ITR-2, because your total income is above 50 lakh.
params.label: why_income

params.name: why_houses
params.default: ITR-2, because you have more than two house properties.
params.label: why_houses

params.name: why_cg
params.default: ITR-2, because of capital gains beyond 112A gains of 1.25 lakh.
params.label: why_cg

params.name: why_agri
params.default: ITR-2, because agricultural income is above 5,000.
params.label: why_agri

params.name: why_director
params.default: ITR-2, because you were a company director or held unlisted shares.
params.label: why_director

params.name: why_foreign
params.default: ITR-2, because of assets or income outside India.
params.label: why_foreign

params.name: why_other
params.default: ITR-2, because of losses carried forward or income ITR-1 does not take.
params.label: why_other

params.name: schema_ok
params.default: Checked against the department's own schema ({schema}) - it fits.
params.label: schema_ok

params.name: schema_bad
params.default: {n} {n:thing|things} to fill before it fits the department's schema:
params.label: schema_bad

params.name: upload_steps
params.default: Sign in at incometax.gov.in|e-File > Income Tax Returns > File Income Tax Return|AY 2026-27 · Online · your status · the form shown here|Choose 'Upload JSON' (or open it in the department's offline utility) and pick this file|Check the pages, pay any tax due first, then submit|e-Verify with Aadhaar OTP within 30 days
params.label: upload_steps

params.name: file_note
params.default: SimplyFile prepares the return; you file it yourself on the e-filing portal. Keep the documents you used - the department may ask for them.
params.label: file_note

params.name: bad_ext
params.default: That kind of file is not read here - send {exts}.
params.label: bad_ext

params.name: no_doc
params.default: That document is not in this return.
params.label: no_doc

params.name: bad_field
params.default: That field ({field}) is not one this return keeps.
params.label: bad_field

params.name: unknown_doc
params.default: This does not look like a pre-filled JSON, AIS, Form 16 or 26AS. Send one of those.
params.label: unknown_doc

params.name: need_password
params.default: This PDF is locked - type its password above and send it again.
params.label: need_password

params.name: bad_password
params.default: That password does not open this PDF.
params.label: bad_password

params.name: scanned
params.default: This PDF has no text layer (a scan or photo). Tick 'Read with AI' to read it, or type the figures under Review.
params.label: scanned

params.name: ai_failed
params.default: The AI could not read it ({why}). Type the figures under Review.
params.label: ai_failed

params.name: no_ai_key
params.default: No AI key is set up on this portal, so only the usual layouts are read. Type the rest under Review.
params.label: no_ai_key

params.name: ay_mismatch
params.default: This document is for AY {theirs}, not AY {ours}.
params.label: ay_mismatch

params.name: pan_mismatch
params.default: This document is for PAN {theirs}, not {ours}.
params.label: pan_mismatch

params.name: pick_new_sub
params.default: No client to add first. Drop your Form 16, the pre-filled JSON or a return already filed - the person is made from it (PAN, name, date of birth). Form 16, AIS and 26AS go in after.
params.label: pick new sub

params.name: no_who
params.default: This file does not name the person. Start with your Form 16, the pre-filled JSON or a filed return; AIS and 26AS come after.
params.label: no who

params.name: found_old
params.default: {name} was already here - added to their return.
params.label: found old

params.name: k_other_why
params.default: Files not read - locked, or not a pre-filled JSON, AIS, Form 16, 26AS or filed return. Remove and send again (with the password if it is locked).
params.label: k_other_why

params.name: k_other_how
params.default: Remove the file with the bin|Type the PDF password above (AIS: PAN in small letters + date of birth DDMMYYYY)|Drop the file again and press Read
params.label: k_other_how

params.name: how_h
params.default: How your return is put together
params.label: how_h

params.name: how_steps
params.default: Start: drop your Form 16, the pre-filled JSON or a return already filed - your PAN is read from it and your return is made (no client to add first).|Add the rest in any order: 26AS (TDS credited to you, FD interest under 194A, dividends under 194), AIS / TIS (savings interest, tax you paid yourself), last filed return (to compare).|Locked PDFs (AIS, TIS, 26AS) open by themselves once your date of birth is known - from the pre-filled JSON or a filed return. Otherwise type the password: PAN in small letters + date of birth DDMMYYYY.|Each figure comes from the document trusted most for it: salary and deductions from Form 16, TDS from 26AS, other income from AIS (else 26AS). Check shows where each one came from; a figure you type wins.|The same file again replaces it - the old one is kept. History (top right) shows every file added or removed, with the earlier version to download.|File: say if it is already filed (date, acknowledgement number), pick the regime, and download the department's JSON. Compare lines each figure up with the filed return.
params.label: how_steps

params.name: rv_paid_p
params.default: Advance tax and self-assessment tax (challan 280). The AIS shows these up to the day it was downloaded - add any paid after it, e.g. with the return.
params.label: rv_paid_p

params.name: pd_none
params.default: Only what the documents show. Add a payment they do not.
params.label: pd_none

params.name: ask_start_h
params.default: A return for AY {ay} is already under way
params.label: ask_start_h

params.name: ask_start_p
params.default: {name}'s return for AY {ay} already holds {n} documents. Carry on with it and add this file, or start again with this file alone?
params.label: ask_start_p

params.name: ask_continue_sub
params.default: Keep everything gathered so far and add this file.
params.label: ask_continue_sub

params.name: ask_fresh_sub
params.default: An empty return with this file alone. Every earlier document stays in History, ready to download.
params.label: ask_fresh_sub

params.name: ask_same_h
params.default: Your {kind} for AY {ay} is already here
params.label: ask_same_h

params.name: ask_same_p
params.default: This return already holds the {kind} shown below. Replace it with the new file, or keep both?
params.label: ask_same_p

params.name: ask_replace_sub
params.default: Use the new file. The one it replaces stays in History.
params.label: ask_replace_sub

params.name: ask_keep_sub
params.default: Hold on to both - the first one read is used for the figures.
params.label: ask_keep_sub

params.name: why_presumptive
params.default: Income from a profession or business worked out on the presumptive basis (44ADA / 44AD), with nothing ITR-1 would refuse - ITR-4 (Sugam).
params.label: why presumptive

params.name: why_biz_more
params.default: Presumptive business or profession income together with something ITR-4 cannot hold (other capital gains, foreign assets, a directorship...) - ITR-3.
params.label: why biz more

params.name: why_biz_limit
params.default: Receipts are above the presumptive limit, so the income cannot be worked out on the presumptive basis - books of account and ITR-3.
params.label: why biz limit

params.name: rv_biz_p
params.default: A freelancer, consultant or contractor without books: 44ADA (doctors, lawyers, engineers, architects, consultants, IT professionals - 50% of receipts) or 44AD (any other business - 6% of bank receipts, 8% of cash). Receipts come from your bank statement and invoices; the department's view of them is in the AIS and 26AS.
params.label: rv biz p

params.name: biz_seen
params.default: The department has seen {amount} paid to you (TDS 194J / 194C...)
params.label: biz seen

params.name: biz_seen_more
params.default: Receipts typed are less than the {amount} the department has seen paid to you - check your bank statement.
params.label: biz seen more

params.name: biz_over
params.default: Receipts {receipts} are over the {limit} limit - presumptive income is not open; this needs books and ITR-3.
params.label: biz over

params.name: biz_pick
params.default: Pick the nature of the work
params.label: biz pick

params.name: k_bank_why
params.default: For a profession or business with no Form 16: the receipts in the year. Kept with your return.
params.label: k bank why

params.name: src_rows
params.default: Form 16|Your employer (TRACES), by 15 June|Salary, exemptions, deductions declared, TDS on salary||Form 26AS|Income Tax Department - incometax.gov.in > e-File > Income Tax Returns > View Form 26AS (TRACES)|Every TDS / TCS credited to your PAN||AIS and TIS|Income Tax Department - incometax.gov.in > Services > AIS|Interest, dividends, sales of shares and funds, business receipts, tax you paid (advance, self-assessment)||Pre-filled JSON|Income Tax Department - e-File > Income Tax Returns > Download Pre-Filled Data|Who you are, banks, salary, TDS, taxes paid||Filed return (JSON)|You - e-File > Income Tax Returns > View Filed Returns|Last year's figures, your date of birth, to compare||Bank statement|Your bank - net banking > statements|Receipts of a profession or business with no TDS||GST returns|gst.gov.in > Returns > View filed returns|Turnover of a GST-registered business||Capital gains statement|Your broker / CAMS / KFintech|Each sale of shares and funds||Proofs|Lender, insurer, LIC, PPF, NPS, landlord|Home loan interest, 80C, 80D, rent (old regime)
params.label: src rows

params.name: pd_bsr_p
params.default: On the challan (or e-Pay Tax > Payment history): the department matches a payment by its BSR code, date and challan number.
params.label: pd_bsr_p

params.name: f10iea
params.default: Business income in the old regime needs Form 10-IEA filed by the due date - file it on the e-filing portal before this return.
params.label: f10iea

params.name: k_bank_how
params.default: Net banking > Accounts > Statement|Choose 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026|Download as PDF or Excel and drop it here
params.label: k bank how

params.name: bank_kept
params.default: Kept with your return - add the year's receipts under Business or profession on Check.
params.label: bank kept

params.name: fd_bank_receipts
params.default: Receipts (not interest, refunds, salary or own transfers)
params.label: fd bank receipts

params.name: no_bank_table
params.default: This statement's table could not be found - is it the statement itself (date, narration, credit, balance)? Excel or CSV reads best.
params.label: no bank table

params.name: biz_from_bank
params.default: Bank statements: receipts {receipts} and cash deposits {cash} - use these as the receipts?
params.label: biz from bank

params.name: biz_used_bank
params.default: Receipts set from the bank statements.
params.label: biz used bank

params.name: from_filed_done
params.default: Filed on {date}, acknowledgement {ack}, {n} tax payments - taken from the filed return.
params.label: from_filed_done

params.name: from_filed_none
params.default: No return filed for AY {ay} is here - drop this year's filed return (JSON) first.
params.label: from_filed_none

params.name: why_huf
params.default: A Hindu undivided family cannot use ITR-1 (it is for individuals) - ITR-2.
params.label: why_huf

params.name: bad_karta_pan
params.default: The Karta's PAN is a person's PAN - its 4th letter is P.
params.label: bad_karta_pan

params.name: more_via_p
params.default: Less common ones - a dependant's disability, treating a serious illness, special loans, rent with no HRA, gifts to a party. Each needs the details the department's schedule asks for.
params.label: more_via_p

params.name: dd_type_1
params.default: Autism, cerebral palsy or multiple disabilities
params.label: dd_type_1

params.name: f_c80eea
params.default: 80EEA - interest on an affordable first-home loan (2019-22)
params.label: f_c80eea

params.name: f_c80gg
params.default: 80GG - rent paid (no HRA from an employer)
params.label: f_c80gg

params.name: f_c80ggc
params.default: 80GGC - given to a political party (not in cash)
params.label: f_c80ggc

params.name: f_stamp
params.default: Stamp duty value of the house
params.label: f_stamp

description_nl: 2026-10-06: every word of My return - the steps, the documents and how to get each, the checks, the regimes, the review fields, the form and how to file it. 2026-10-06: start from documents. 2026-10-06: an Other card for files not read, so a locked one can be removed. 2026-10-06: how_h / how_steps - the step-by-step shown on Gather. 2026-10-06: rv_paid / pd_* - tax the person paid themselves, typed on Check. 2026-10-06: ask_* - the two questions before a file goes in: a return already under way (carry on / start again) and a second AIS / 26AS (replace / keep both). 2026-10-06: the business card on Check (44ADA / 44AD), the ITR-4 reasons, and where each document comes from. 2026-10-06: pd_bsr / pd_challan - a typed payment's BSR code and challan number; f10iea. 2026-10-06: k_bank_how, bank_kept, src_issuer, src_gives. 2026-10-06: the bank statement's figures on its card and on the business card. 2026-10-06: pw_show / pw_hide - the eye on the PDF password. 2026-10-06: back_to - the Back button on each step. 2026-10-06: from_filed / from_filed_done / from_filed_none. 2026-10-06: why_huf. 2026-10-06: the Karta's fields for an HUF. 2026-10-06: the More deductions panel on Check.

expect_value.ready_p: Ten minutes of gathering saves an hour of guessing. Each one you drop in below ticks itself; tick the rest as you have them.
expect_value.k_filed_why: Already filed? Drop in the JSON you filed and every figure is set beside this one.
expect_value.k_filed_how: Sign in at incometax.gov.in|e-File > Income Tax Returns > View Filed Returns|Pick AY {ay} and download the JSON (or keep the one you uploaded)|Drop it here
expect_value.no_filed: No filed return in this one yet - drop in the JSON you filed.
expect_value.filed_p: Give the day you filed - the dates, the late fee, interest and the regime are then worked out as of that day.
expect_value.cmp_h: Compared with the return you filed
expect_value.cmp_p: {file}: {filed} as filed, {ours} as made here. A gap means one of the two has a figure the other does not.
expect_value.cmp_same: Every figure agrees with the return you filed.
expect_value.why_simple: ITR-1 (Sahaj) fits: resident, income up to 50 lakh, salary, up to two houses and other sources.
expect_value.why_nonres: ITR-2, because you were not resident in India this year.
expect_value.why_income: ITR-2, because your total income is above 50 lakh.
expect_value.why_houses: ITR-2, because you have more than two house properties.
expect_value.why_cg: ITR-2, because of capital gains beyond 112A gains of 1.25 lakh.
expect_value.why_agri: ITR-2, because agricultural income is above 5,000.
expect_value.why_director: ITR-2, because you were a company director or held unlisted shares.
expect_value.why_foreign: ITR-2, because of assets or income outside India.
expect_value.why_other: ITR-2, because of losses carried forward or income ITR-1 does not take.
expect_value.schema_ok: Checked against the department's own schema ({schema}) - it fits.
expect_value.schema_bad: {n} {n:thing|things} to fill before it fits the department's schema:
expect_value.upload_steps: Sign in at incometax.gov.in|e-File > Income Tax Returns > File Income Tax Return|AY 2026-27 · Online · your status · the form shown here|Choose 'Upload JSON' (or open it in the department's offline utility) and pick this file|Check the pages, pay any tax due first, then submit|e-Verify with Aadhaar OTP within 30 days
expect_value.file_note: SimplyFile prepares the return; you file it yourself on the e-filing portal. Keep the documents you used - the department may ask for them.
expect_value.bad_ext: That kind of file is not read here - send {exts}.
expect_value.no_doc: That document is not in this return.
expect_value.bad_field: That field ({field}) is not one this return keeps.
expect_value.unknown_doc: This does not look like a pre-filled JSON, AIS, Form 16 or 26AS. Send one of those.
expect_value.need_password: This PDF is locked - type its password above and send it again.
expect_value.bad_password: That password does not open this PDF.
expect_value.scanned: This PDF has no text layer (a scan or photo). Tick 'Read with AI' to read it, or type the figures under Review.
expect_value.ai_failed: The AI could not read it ({why}). Type the figures under Review.
expect_value.no_ai_key: No AI key is set up on this portal, so only the usual layouts are read. Type the rest under Review.
expect_value.ay_mismatch: This document is for AY {theirs}, not AY {ours}.
expect_value.pan_mismatch: This document is for PAN {theirs}, not {ours}.
expect_value.pick_new_sub: No client to add first. Drop your Form 16, the pre-filled JSON or a return already filed - the person is made from it (PAN, name, date of birth). Form 16, AIS and 26AS go in after.
expect_value.no_who: This file does not name the person. Start with your Form 16, the pre-filled JSON or a filed return; AIS and 26AS come after.
expect_value.found_old: {name} was already here - added to their return.
expect_value.k_other_why: Files not read - locked, or not a pre-filled JSON, AIS, Form 16, 26AS or filed return. Remove and send again (with the password if it is locked).
expect_value.k_other_how: Remove the file with the bin|Type the PDF password above (AIS: PAN in small letters + date of birth DDMMYYYY)|Drop the file again and press Read
expect_value.how_h: How your return is put together
expect_value.how_steps: Start: drop your Form 16, the pre-filled JSON or a return already filed - your PAN is read from it and your return is made (no client to add first).|Add the rest in any order: 26AS (TDS credited to you, FD interest under 194A, dividends under 194), AIS / TIS (savings interest, tax you paid yourself), last filed return (to compare).|Locked PDFs (AIS, TIS, 26AS) open by themselves once your date of birth is known - from the pre-filled JSON or a filed return. Otherwise type the password: PAN in small letters + date of birth DDMMYYYY.|Each figure comes from the document trusted most for it: salary and deductions from Form 16, TDS from 26AS, other income from AIS (else 26AS). Check shows where each one came from; a figure you type wins.|The same file again replaces it - the old one is kept. History (top right) shows every file added or removed, with the earlier version to download.|File: say if it is already filed (date, acknowledgement number), pick the regime, and download the department's JSON. Compare lines each figure up with the filed return.
expect_value.rv_paid_p: Advance tax and self-assessment tax (challan 280). The AIS shows these up to the day it was downloaded - add any paid after it, e.g. with the return.
expect_value.pd_none: Only what the documents show. Add a payment they do not.
expect_value.ask_start_h: A return for AY {ay} is already under way
expect_value.ask_start_p: {name}'s return for AY {ay} already holds {n} documents. Carry on with it and add this file, or start again with this file alone?
expect_value.ask_continue_sub: Keep everything gathered so far and add this file.
expect_value.ask_fresh_sub: An empty return with this file alone. Every earlier document stays in History, ready to download.
expect_value.ask_same_h: Your {kind} for AY {ay} is already here
expect_value.ask_same_p: This return already holds the {kind} shown below. Replace it with the new file, or keep both?
expect_value.ask_replace_sub: Use the new file. The one it replaces stays in History.
expect_value.ask_keep_sub: Hold on to both - the first one read is used for the figures.
expect_value.why_presumptive: Income from a profession or business worked out on the presumptive basis (44ADA / 44AD), with nothing ITR-1 would refuse - ITR-4 (Sugam).
expect_value.why_biz_more: Presumptive business or profession income together with something ITR-4 cannot hold (other capital gains, foreign assets, a directorship...) - ITR-3.
expect_value.why_biz_limit: Receipts are above the presumptive limit, so the income cannot be worked out on the presumptive basis - books of account and ITR-3.
expect_value.rv_biz_p: A freelancer, consultant or contractor without books: 44ADA (doctors, lawyers, engineers, architects, consultants, IT professionals - 50% of receipts) or 44AD (any other business - 6% of bank receipts, 8% of cash). Receipts come from your bank statement and invoices; the department's view of them is in the AIS and 26AS.
expect_value.biz_seen: The department has seen {amount} paid to you (TDS 194J / 194C...)
expect_value.biz_seen_more: Receipts typed are less than the {amount} the department has seen paid to you - check your bank statement.
expect_value.biz_over: Receipts {receipts} are over the {limit} limit - presumptive income is not open; this needs books and ITR-3.
expect_value.biz_pick: Pick the nature of the work
expect_value.k_bank_why: For a profession or business with no Form 16: the receipts in the year. Kept with your return.

expect_value.pd_bsr_p: On the challan (or e-Pay Tax > Payment history): the department matches a payment by its BSR code, date and challan number.
expect_value.f10iea: Business income in the old regime needs Form 10-IEA filed by the due date - file it on the e-filing portal before this return.
expect_value.k_bank_how: Net banking > Accounts > Statement|Choose 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026|Download as PDF or Excel and drop it here
expect_value.bank_kept: Kept with your return - add the year's receipts under Business or profession on Check.
expect_value.fd_bank_receipts: Receipts (not interest, refunds, salary or own transfers)
expect_value.no_bank_table: This statement's table could not be found - is it the statement itself (date, narration, credit, balance)? Excel or CSV reads best.
expect_value.biz_from_bank: Bank statements: receipts {receipts} and cash deposits {cash} - use these as the receipts?
expect_value.biz_used_bank: Receipts set from the bank statements.
expect_value.from_filed_done: Filed on {date}, acknowledgement {ack}, {n} tax payments - taken from the filed return.
expect_value.from_filed_none: No return filed for AY {ay} is here - drop this year's filed return (JSON) first.
expect_value.why_huf: A Hindu undivided family cannot use ITR-1 (it is for individuals) - ITR-2.
expect_value.bad_karta_pan: The Karta's PAN is a person's PAN - its 4th letter is P.
expect_value.more_via_p: Less common ones - a dependant's disability, treating a serious illness, special loans, rent with no HRA, gifts to a party. Each needs the details the department's schedule asks for.
expect_value.dd_type_1: Autism, cerebral palsy or multiple disabilities
expect_value.f_c80eea: 80EEA - interest on an affordable first-home loan (2019-22)
expect_value.f_c80gg: 80GG - rent paid (no HRA from an employer)
expect_value.f_c80ggc: 80GGC - given to a political party (not in cash)
